evidence_verification_code_layer_check.name: evidence_verification_code_layer_check
evidence_verification_code_layer_check.value:
(
        "evidence"."verification_status" in ('SUBMITTED', 'REJECTED') and "evidence"."confirmed_code" is null
      ) or (
        "evidence"."verification_status" in ('RULE_VERIFIED', 'TEACHER_VERIFIED') and "evidence"."confirmed_code" is not null and (
          ("evidence"."signal_layer" = 'INPUT' and "evidence"."confirmed_code" = 'INPUT_OK') or
          ("evidence"."signal_layer" = 'MAPPING' and "evidence"."confirmed_code" = 'MAPPING_OK') or
          ("evidence"."signal_layer" = 'TRANSPORT' and "evidence"."confirmed_code" = 'TRANSPORT_OK') or
          ("evidence"."signal_layer" = 'BINDING' and "evidence"."confirmed_code" = 'BINDING_OK') or
          ("evidence"."signal_layer" = 'OUTPUT' and "evidence"."confirmed_code" = 'OUTPUT_OK')
        )
      )

evidence_original_name_length_check.name: evidence_original_name_length_check
evidence_original_name_length_check.value: "evidence"."original_name" is null or length("evidence"."original_name") between 1 and 120

student_identity_codes_claim_state_check.name: student_identity_codes_claim_state_check
student_identity_codes_claim_state_check.value: ("student_identity_codes"."claimed_user_id" is null and "student_identity_codes"."claimed_at" is null) or ("student_identity_codes"."claimed_user_id" is not null and "student_identity_codes"."claimed_at" is not null)

tool_path_plans_requirements_json_check.name: tool_path_plans_requirements_json_check
tool_path_plans_requirements_json_check.value: json_valid("tool_path_plans"."requirements_json") and json_type("tool_path_plans"."requirements_json") = 'object' and coalesce(json_type("tool_path_plans"."requirements_json", '$.needsRealtimeVisuals'), '') in ('true', 'false') and coalesce(json_type("tool_path_plans"."requirements_json", '$.needsPhysicalControl'), '') in ('true', 'false') and coalesce(json_type("tool_path_plans"."requirements_json", '$.hasOsc'), '') in ('true', 'false')
